_doc: Known-answer PRs for measuring the reviewer. Each case is a real merged PR, pinned to the commits it had.
kind=bug: the PR shipped a defect that a later PR had to fix (fixed_by). expect.any_keywords are regexes; the
review counts as having found the defect when one of them matches its text (body + inline comments).
kind=control: a PR with no known defect; the reviewer should approve it.
kind=preexisting: the PR touched code that already had a defect it did not introduce; the reviewer should approve (the bar is what this PR breaks) and ideally name it in a heads-up.
Run: scripts/eval-stage.sh <id> → review per evals/RUNNER.md → scripts/eval-grade.py. See README 'Measuring the reviewer'.

cases.truth: StrapiApi.getProgramTemplateExercises asks Strapi to populate `video` / `image`, keys that neither content type has. Strapi v5 rejects the whole request with 400 'Invalid key', so every Standard routine shows "This routine didn't load".

The neck rest pitch is a rolling window of the last 15 calibration frames, but the 'Start the movement now' cue plays while the scan is still calibrating. The window holds the already-moved head, so neck flexion and extension always read about 0° ('I didn't see much movement').
cases.needs: reading the caller (LiveScanShell._beginCount) next to the diff

cases.truth: A spoken delete is confirmed when the item name is a raw substring of the phrase. 'delete banana' confirms deleting 'Ana', 'delete knee reviews' confirms 'Knee review', and a name with punctuation ('Maria S.') is refused. The substring match was already in confirmation_accepted at the base commit; this PR tightened the function around it and left it.
cases.needs: the diff alone; the defect line is unchanged context
